items.raw_excerpt: A Yorkshire Dales market town famed for its cobbled square, independent shops, and as the filming location for All Creatures Great and Small

items.raw_excerpt: The boss of the country's biggest stadium wants the government to crack down on unruly sports fans and follow Australia's lead when it comes to handing out punishments.
items.summary_en: The boss of New Zealand's biggest stadium wants the government to punish bad sports fans. He said New Zealand should follow Australia's example. He spoke after the Warriors lost a game.

items.raw_excerpt: Fremantle pioneer Shaun McManus will hand over the AFL premiership cup to captain Alex Pearce if the Dockers break through for their maiden flag.

items.raw_excerpt: A free outdoor concert headlined by Jann Arden in support of Canadian unity brought thousands to downtown Calgary on Sunday, about a month before Albertans will cast their ballots on the question of separation.
